english.heading: Market Gardening & Community
body: Your garden gives food, income, and useful knowledge.
This module shows how to keep records, sell surplus, and build local food networks.
The aim is a farm that feeds the household and works as a small, clear economy.

body.text: Igadi yakho inika ukutya, ingeniso nolwazi oluluncedo.
Eli candelo libonisa indlela yokugcina iirekhodi, yokuthengisa isivuno esigqithileyo nokwakha uthungelwano lokutya lasekuhlaleni.
Injongo yifama enondla indlu kwaye isebenza njengoqoqosho oluncinci, olucacileyo.

english.heading: Why This Matters
body: A harvest can feed the household, be sold, be shared, or be lost.
Recording these different uses helps you see what the farm produces and what reaches customers.
Use that information to protect household food and make better business decisions.

body.text: Isivuno sinokondla indlu, sithengiswe, sabelwane ngaso, okanye silahleke.
Ukurekhoda ezi ndlela zahlukeneyo zokusetyenziswa kukunceda ubone ukuba ifama ivelisa ntoni nokuba yintoni efika kubathengi.
Sebenzisa loo lwazi ukukhusela ukutya kwendlu nokwenza izigqibo zorhwebo ezingcono.

english.heading: Learning Outcomes
body: By the end, you can record harvests and where they go.
You can work out the true cost of production before setting a price.
You can match surplus to a suitable customer or selling channel.
You can build a local network for seeds, tools, skills, and food.

body.text: Ekupheleni, uya kukwazi ukurekhoda izivuno nalapho ziya khona.
Uya kukwazi ukubala iindleko zenene zemveliso phambi kokumisa ixabiso.
Uya kukwazi ukudibanisa isivuno esigqithileyo nomthengi okanye indlela yokuthengisa efanelekileyo.
Uya kukwazi ukwakha uthungelwano lwasekuhlaleni lwembewu, izixhobo, izakhono nokutya.

english.heading: Watch: What the Farm Record Shows
body: The record follows each harvest to family food, sales, gifts, or compost.
Read across the season to see the farm as an economy before making a business decision.

body.text: Irekhodi lilandela isivuno ngasinye ukuya kukutya kwendlu, kwintengiso, kwizipho okanye kumgquba.
Funda ngexesha lonke lonyaka ukubona ifama njengoqoqosho phambi kokwenza isigqibo sorhwebo.

english.heading: Record Every Harvest
body: Write down every harvest as it happens.
Record kilograms of tomatoes, dozens of eggs, and bundles of morogo, then note where each went.
Use the same simple habit for food kept at home, produce sold, produce gifted, and produce composted.
Do not rely on memory at the end of the season.

body.text: Bhala phantsi sonke isivuno njengoko senzeka.
Rekhoda ii-kg zotamatisi, iidazini zamaqanda, nezithungu zemifino (morogo), uze uqaphele ukuba nganye iye phi.
Sebenzisa isiko elilula elifanayo kukutya okugcinwe ekhaya, kwemveliso ethengisiweyo, kweyaphiwe abanye, nekwenziwe umgquba.
Musa ukuthembela kwinkumbulo ekupheleni kwexesha lonyaka.

english.heading: Let One Season Answer Questions
body: One season of records answers practical questions.
Which crops give the best yield per bed? Which return the most for each hour of work?
Which crops use more seeds, water, and compost than they return?
The record also shows which months leave the household buying food.

heading.text: Vumela ixesha elinye lonyaka liphendule imibuzo

body.text: Iirekhodi zexesha elinye lonyaka ziphendula imibuzo esebenzayo.
Zeziphi izityalo ezinika isivuno esingcono kwibhedi nganye? Zeziphi ezibuyisa okuninzi kwiyure nganye yomsebenzi?
Zeziphi izityalo ezisebenzisa imbewu, amanzi nomgquba ongaphezulu kunokuba zibuyisa?
Irekhodi likwabonisa ukuba zeziphi iinyanga eziyishiya indlu ithenga ukutya.

english.heading: Find the True Cost
body: Before setting a price, record production, packing and selling costs, including labour and transport.
Here is a teaching example, not a market price: tomatoes cost R18 per kilogram but sell for R15 per kilogram. That price does not cover the stated cost.
Review the price, costs and next planting. Check what customers will actually buy; a higher asking price is not a guaranteed sale.

body.text: Phambi kokumisa ixabiso, rekhoda iindleko zemveliso, zokupakisha nezokuthengisa, kuquka umsebenzi nothutho.

Nanku umzekelo wokufundisa, ayingoxabiso lemarike: iindleko zokuvelisa utamatisi ziyiR18 ngekhilogram nganye kodwa uthengiswa ngeR15 ngekhilogram nganye. Eli xabiso alizigubungeli iindleko ezichaziweyo.
Phonononga ixabiso, iindleko nokutyala okulandelayo. Jonga ukuba abathengi baza kuthenga ntoni ngokwenene; ixabiso eliphezulu lokucela asisiqinisekiso sentengiso.

english.heading: Plan for the Food Gap
body: Use your record to find when household food runs short.
Choose locally suitable crops and work backwards from the harvest you need. Check planting conditions and expected time to harvest.
A date that works on another farm may not work here. Include a backup plan when rain, water or crops fail.

body.text: Sebenzisa irekhodi lakho ukufumana ixesha apho ukutya kwendlu kuphela khona.
Khetha izityalo ezifanelekileyo apho uhlala khona, uze usebenze umva usuka kwisivuno oyidingayo. Jonga iimeko zokutyala nexesha elilindelekileyo lokuvuna.
Umhla osebenza kwenye ifama usenokungasebenzi apha. Quka isicwangciso sasemva xa imvula, amanzi okanye izityalo zisilela.

english.heading: Watch: Where Surplus Can Go
body: Surplus can leave the farm through a roadside stall, a group delivery to a shop, or a box delivered to a household.
The arrows show each route.

heading.text: Bukela: apho isivuno esigqithileyo sinokuya khona

body.text: Isivuno esigqithileyo sinokuphuma kwifama ngesitali sasecaleni kwendlela, ngokuhanjiswa liqela evenkileni, okanye ngebhokisi ehanjiswa kwindlu.
Iintolo zibonisa indlela nganye.

english.heading: Know Your Customer
body: Ask what the customer needs: product, quantity, quality, delivery and payment date.
Compare market fees, transport, packing and unsold produce as well as the selling price.
Check the market rules and local trading and food requirements. An informal stall does not automatically have no rules or costs.

body.text: Buza ukuba umthengi ufuna ntoni: imveliso, ubuninzi, umgangatho, ukuhanjiswa nomhla wentlawulo.
Thelekisa iifizi zemarike, uthutho, ukupakisha neemveliso ezingathengiswanga kunye nexabiso lokuthengisa.
Jonga imithetho yemarike kunye neemfuno zasekuhlaleni zorhwebo nezokutya. Isitali esingekho sesikweni asiyonto ngokuzenzekelayo engenamithetho okanye iindleko.

english.heading: Count the Work of Direct Selling
body: Direct selling can retain more of the sale price, but it also takes time, packing, transport and customer care.
A box scheme supplies a regular selection to agreed customers.
Agree the contents, price, payment and what happens when crops are short. Regular orders help planning only when customers and growers can keep the agreement.

body.text: Ukuthengisa ngqo kunokugcina inxalenye enkulu yexabiso lentengiso, kodwa kuthatha ixesha, ukupakisha, uthutho nokukhathalela abathengi.
Inkqubo yeebhokisi (box scheme) ibonelela ngokhetho oluqhelekileyo lweemveliso rhoqo kubathengi abavumelene nawe.

Vumelanani ngezinto eziya ebhokisini, ixabiso, intlawulo nento eyenzekayo xa izityalo zinqabile. Iiodolo eziqhelekileyo zinceda ukucwangcisa kuphela xa abathengi nabalimi bekwazi ukugcina isivumelwano.

english.heading: Plan Around Real Orders
body: Start from what you can reliably supply and what customers want.
Check the costs and household food needs before promising regular boxes.
Garden area or customer count alone does not predict income. Try a manageable arrangement and record the results.

body.text: Qala kwinto onokuyibonelela ngokuthembekileyo nakwinto abayifunayo abathengi.
Jonga iindleko nezidingo zokutya kwendlu phambi kokuthembisa iibhokisi eziqhelekileyo.
Ubungakanani begadi okanye inani labathengi kuphela alikuxeleli ingeniso. Zama ulungiselelo onokululawula uze urekhode iziphumo.

english.heading: Match the Channel to Your Supply
body: If production changes from week to week, avoid promising a fixed delivery you cannot supply.
Offer the surplus you have and agree clear terms with customers.
Describe your growing practices honestly. Check any certification or claim the buyer requires before using a label.

body.text: Ukuba imveliso iyatshintsha evekini ngeveki, phepha ukuthembisa ukuhanjiswa okungatshintshiyo ongenako ukukubonelela.
Nikela ngesivuno esigqithileyo onaso uze uvumelane ngemiqathango ecacileyo nabathengi.
Chaza iindlela zakho zokulima ngokunyanisekileyo. Jonga nasiphi na isatifikethi okanye isibango abasifunayo abathengi phambi kokusebenzisa ileyibhile.

english.heading: Watch: How Neighbours Strengthen a Harvest
body: One farm can produce food.
A group can share seed, tools, skills, and transport.
Separate growers become a stronger local food network, with each household contributing what it can.

heading.text: Bukela: indlela abamelwane abomeleza ngayo isivuno

body.text: Ifama enye inokuvelisa ukutya.
Iqela linokwabelana ngembewu, izixhobo, izakhono nothutho.
Abalimi abahlukeneyo baba luthungelwano lokutya lasekuhlaleni olomeleleyo, indlu nganye inegalelo ngokokukwazi kwayo.

english.heading: Save Seed Together
body: Neighbours can share different varieties and the work of saving seed.
Record the crop, variety, source and collection date. Plan suitable isolation, selection, drying and storage for each crop.
Sharing does not automatically multiply diversity or improve quality. Check identity and germination before relying on shared seed.
Before exchanging seed, check whether the variety is protected and whether permission is needed.

body.text: Abamelwane banokwabelana ngeentlobo ezahlukeneyo nangomsebenzi wokugcina imbewu.
Rekhoda isityalo, uhlobo, umthombo nomhla wokuqokelelwa. Cwangcisa ukwahlula (ukugcina izityalo zahlukene) okufanelekileyo, ukukhetha, ukomisa nokugcina kwisityalo ngasinye.
Ukwabelana akwandisi ngokuzenzekelayo ukwahluka okanye akuphuculi umgangatho. Qinisekisa ukuba imbewu yintoni ngokwenene nokuba iyahluma na phambi kokuthembela kwimbewu eyabelwanayo.
Phambi kokutshintshisana ngembewu, jonga ukuba ngaba uhlobo lukhuselwe na nokuba imvume iyadingeka na.

english.heading: Share Expensive Tools
body: Tool sharing puts expensive equipment within reach of the group.
A water pump or grain mill may be beyond one household’s budget.
Shared use spreads the value across the group and helps each farm do work it could not do alone.

body.text: Ukwabelana ngezixhobo kwenza izixhobo ezibizayo zifikeleleke eqeleni.
Impompo yamanzi okanye umshini wokugaya iinkozo usenokungafikeleleki kwibhajethi yendlu enye.
Ukusetyenziswa ngokwabelana kusasaza ixabiso eqeleni kuze kunceda ifama nganye yenze umsebenzi eyayinokungawenza yodwa.

english.heading: Reduce Loss Between Harvest and Sale
body: Handle produce gently and keep suitable shade, packaging and storage through delivery.
A nearby buyer may reduce the journey, but losses and selling costs still need measuring.
Compare the money received after fees, transport and spoilage for each option. Do not assume the nearest buyer always gives the best return.

body.text: Phatha isivuno ngobunono uze ugcine umthunzi, ukupakisha nokugcinwa okufanelekileyo kude kugqitywe ukuhanjiswa.
Umthengi okufutshane usenokunciphisa uhambo, kodwa iilahleko neendleko zokuthengisa zisafuna ukulinganiswa.
Thelekisa imali efunyenweyo emva kweefizi, uthutho nokonakala kwindlela nganye. Musa ukuthatha ukuba umthengi okufutshane ngowona unika inzuzo engcono rhoqo.

english.heading: Share Skills and Check Results
body: Neighbours can demonstrate useful skills and compare what happened on their own farms.
Record the method, conditions and result so others can judge whether it may suit their land.
Seek qualified advice for unfamiliar disease or technical problems. Shared experience and specialist help can work together.

body.text: Abamelwane banokubonisa izakhono eziluncedo baze bathelekise okwenzeka kumafama abo.
Rekhoda indlela, iimeko nesiphumo ukuze abanye bagwebe ukuba ingaba ingafanela umhlaba wabo.
Funa ingcebiso evela kwabaqeqeshiweyo xa kukho isifo esingaqhelekanga okanye iingxaki zobuchwephesha. Amava abelwanayo noncedo lwabachwephesha zinokusebenza kunye.

english.heading: Field Assignment: Make a Farm Record
body: Use headings for harvest, where it went, costs, and labour.
Record every kilogram, dozen, or bundle as it leaves the farm.
Include food kept by the household, produce sold, produce gifted, and produce composted.
At the end of one season, identify a crop that returns well and a month when the household buys food.

body.text: Sebenzisa izihloko zesivuno, apho siye khona, iindleko nomsebenzi.
Rekhoda ikhilogram nganye, idazini okanye isithungu njengoko ishiya ifama.
Quka ukutya okugcinwe ngumzi, imveliso ethengisiweyo, eyaphiwe abanye, nekwenziwe umgquba.
Ekupheleni kwexesha elinye lonyaka, chonga isityalo esibuyisa kakuhle kunye nenyanga apho indlu ithenga ukutya.

english.heading: Field Action: Use the Record
body: Choose one real decision from your farm record.
Compare the cost and return of a crop or selling route, or plan for a household food gap using local growing conditions.

Then agree one practical seed swap, tool share, shared delivery or skills session with neighbours. Before a seed swap, check whether the variety is protected and whether permission is needed. Record responsibilities and review what happens.

body.text: Khetha isigqibo esinye sokwenene kwirekhodi lefama yakho.
Thelekisa iindleko nenzuzo yesityalo okanye yendlela yokuthengisa, okanye ucwangcise isikhewu sokutya kwendlu usebenzisa iimeko zasekuhlaleni zokukhula.

Emva koko vumelana nabamelwane ngomsebenzi omnye osebenzayo: ukutshintshisana ngembewu, ukwabelana ngezixhobo, ukuhambisa kunye okanye iseshoni yezakhono. Phambi kokutshintshisana ngembewu, jonga ukuba ngaba uhlobo lukhuselwe na nokuba imvume iyadingeka na. Rekhoda uxanduva uze uphonononge okwenzekayo.
